half_sector_monotonicity.consequence: before the sector bisector the outer envelope has no -a-only step; after reflection it has no +b-only step. Thus all Motzkin +1 symbols precede all -1 symbols.

definitions.N_triangle_occupancy: UP(a,b) occupied iff q(3a+1,3b+1)<=9r^2; DOWN(a,b) occupied iff q(3a+2,3b+2)<=9r^2
definitions.dual_selected: vertex p is selected iff it is endpoint of at least one lattice edge whose two incident N triangles are occupied

event_criterion.new_pair: Delta J_N(r)=1 iff shell m=r+j+1 exists
event_criterion.tie: equality has no solution for r>=1 because it would imply an integer ratio equal to the irrational positive root of y^2+6y-3=0

semantic_typing.N_q: frozen N-resolver bridge classifier, not promoted to Enterprise native metric

shell_minimization.assume: by a<->b symmetry take a>=b and a+b=m
shell_minimization.uniform_integer_equivalence: for even m the alternative inequality 9k^2-3k+1/4<=3r^2 is equivalent because 3r^2-9k^2+3k is integer
